point.identity_review: The primary maintenance tender names KNDC on parcel IS-011 and the Google feature names the Konza data center. The AfDB-disclosed adjacent-laboratory report independently photographs the data-centre building immediately south of its published camera location, consistent with this point. The primary handbook parcel diagram is schematic and its road-side detail differs from the imagery; it is not used to assert a boundary or transform the point. The point locates the existing facility rather than an office, university or whole technopolis.
point.uncertainty_reason: Named map-feature accuracy is unknown. No surveyed horizontal uncertainty, building footprint or cadastral containment claim is available.
